headerDisplay:
### SwitchBot OpenAPI Setup
1. Open the **SwitchBot** app on your phone.
2. Go to **Profile** → **Preferences**.
3. Tap **App Version** 10 times to unlock **Developer Options**.
4. Copy your **Token** and **Secret** below.

token.title: OpenAPI Token
token.description: Your SwitchBot Developer Token (or ${SWITCHBOT_TOKEN} environment variable).

secret.title: OpenAPI Secret
secret.description: Your SwitchBot Developer Secret key (or ${SWITCHBOT_SECRET} environment variable).

refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refreshInterval.description: Interval to poll device state. Minimum is 10 seconds (default: 60).

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: 12-character ID from Device Info in SwitchBot App.
